proposal.description: The comparator is sampled only at the switching-cycle boundary for the restart, so a comparator dip that recovers before the next PWM falling edge does not restart the qualifying count
proposal.reason: With the counter at TARGET (PGOOD high), a pgood_comp low pulse of a few clocks with no pwm_fall inside it drops PGOOD, but PGOOD comes back as soon as pgood_comp returns instead of staying low for the full PGOOD_DELAY_CYCLES qualifying period. Mid-count dips are skipped the same way, so PGOOD asserts early.

proposal.description: A departure from S_RUN restarts the qualifying count only if it is seen on a switching-cycle boundary, so leaving S_RUN between PWM falling edges (or while PWM is stopped) leaves the count intact
proposal.reason: If run_active drops and returns with no pwm_fall in between while pgood_comp stays high, the counter keeps its value. If it was at TARGET, PGOOD reasserts as soon as run_active returns instead of waiting the full delay after re-entering S_RUN.

proposal.description: The qualifying counter advances on every clock while the PWM is high, not once per switching cycle at the PWM falling edge
proposal.reason: With run_active and pgood_comp held high, the counter reaches TARGET after PGOOD_DELAY_CYCLES clocks of PWM high time, not PGOOD_DELAY_CYCLES switching cycles. PGOOD then asserts much sooner than the qualifying period.
